Standard Fender Eliminator Features

Description

Get rid of the bulky stock fender on your 2017+ Ninja 650 / Z650 with one of our high quality and easy to install fender eliminator kits. With no cutting or drilling required, you can give the tail section of your Kawasaki an overhaul that won't damage any OEM components. Each kit is engineered with modern computer design techniques and manufactured employing modern CNC machinery. Our Standard Fender Eliminator offers a lightweight design as well as a lightweight impact on your wallet, providing a great "bang for your buck" kit that can easily transform the looks of your Ninja 650 / Z650. We also offer two different Elite-1 kits, Adjustable or Standard. Both Elite-1 kits include our CNC machined Undertail Closeout and not only cleans up the looks of the undertail fairing, but also prevents water or debris from entering through the hole left behind from the OEM fender removal. The Elite-1 Fender Eliminator is an all-inclusive kit that is sure to provide a sleek and race-inspired look to your Kawasaki Ninja 650 or Z650.

Description

License plate lights are necessary to make your motorcycle street legal, but do they have to be so bulky and ugly? When you setup your Ducati, Honda, Suzuki, Kawasaki, Yamaha, or whatever your choice of ride is with a custom license plate mount, you probably don't want to add bulk just to illuminate the license plate. Some companies answered this need with cheap lights that do not function well and are difficult to install and connect. Other companies have created lights that look fancy because of a machined aluminum enclosure but are expensive, not universal, and still difficult to install. At TST Industries, we design our products to solve problems that we find in our industry. Our new Low-Profile License Plate Light not only solves these problems, it also adds style to your vehicle, installs with ease, and is available at a very attractive price point.

This new design utilizes high strength Hibond peel and stick adhesive for positioning and is the primary installation method. This same adhesive is used in the aerospace and automotive industry for bonding components to frames and panels. Aircraft builders use it on flying machines so you know it can be trusted! This means of installation is guaranteed to hold the license plate light onto the license plate for the life of the vehicle if applied correctly to a clean surface. It withstands extreme high and low temperatures, water, and forces much larger than the ones generated by road vibration and bumps. After adhering it to the back of the license plate, the light is then clamped between the plate bracket and the license plate for added security and peace of mind for those who doubt the effectiveness of the adhesive.

Description

License plate lights are necessary to make your motorcycle street legal, but do they have to be so bulky and ugly? When you setup your Ducati, Honda, Suzuki, Kawasaki, Yamaha, or whatever your choice of ride is with a custom license plate mount, you probably don't want to add bulk just to illuminate the license plate. Some companies answered this need with cheap lights that do not function well and are difficult to install and connect. Other companies have created lights that look fancy because of a machined aluminum enclosure but are expensive, not universal, and still difficult to install. At TST Industries, we design our products to solve problems that we find in our industry. Our new Low-Profile License Plate Light not only solves these problems, it also adds style to your vehicle, installs with ease, and is available at a very attractive price point.

This new design utilizes high strength Hibond peel and stick adhesive for positioning and is the primary installation method. This same adhesive is used in the aerospace and automotive industry for bonding components to frames and panels. Aircraft builders use it on flying machines so you know it can be trusted! This means of installation is guaranteed to hold the license plate light onto the license plate for the life of the vehicle if applied correctly to a clean surface. It withstands extreme high and low temperatures, water, and forces much larger than the ones generated by road vibration and bumps. After adhering it to the back of the license plate, the light is then clamped between the plate bracket and the license plate for added security and peace of mind for those who doubt the effectiveness of the adhesive.

source_description_html:
Our TST MECH-GTR Running Light Connection Kit provides you with the necessary components that enable a running light function to your MECH-GTR LED Turn Signals. We include our HALO Running Light Modules and the required installation components to help you add some extra style and functionality to your motorcycle.

Our HALO module is an LED circuit board, available in multiple color options, that is a plug and play addition to your MECH-GTR signals. And because many motorcycles don't feature running lights, our connection kit also includes the components necessary to enable that feature with no special tools required.

  • Provides turn signal running light function to TST MECH-GTR LED Turn Signals installed on motorcycles that do not feature running lights
  • Installs in minutes
  • No special tools required for installation
  • 6 super bright LEDs provide ample light output to create a unique running glow at the MECH-GTR Signal base
  • Available running light colors include:
    • Hyper White
    • Amber
    • Blue
    • Warm White
    • Pink
    • Lemon Yellow
